customers.sheet_no_briefs: This customer has no brief yet.
customers.sheet_no_collabs: No collaboration on this brief yet.

biz.trend_caption: Each month is read on its own from the finance aggregate, and the cost comes from that month’s entry. A month with nothing recorded says so instead of showing a 0.
biz.cost_empty_description: Fixed cost, variable cost and opening cash are the inputs the margin and the cash figure cannot derive from the ledgers.
biz.cost_basis: Amounts are in CNY: the month entry has no currency column.
biz.affiliate_caption: Creator commission is money the platform pays to creators: it counts as GMV, not as our income, so the three blocks are never added together.
biz.affiliate_empty: No affiliate ledger row this month.
biz.month_basis: Signed and collected are this month’s figures from the finance aggregate; the cost is the month’s own entry; margin = collected − cost.
